notes: KINGDOM WARS 1.0.0 build 66 (Tasks I/J battle controls). New battle controls: one bar with UNITS, RETREAT, DEFEND/MARCH (shows the army's current state) and ATTACK, plus a TACTICS tray (Throw Spears with a live count, Charge Swords/Spears/Ranged). Phones get touch-sized buttons with nothing off-screen and no keyboard hints.
